module purpose: This block stores four 32-bit CSR-written words in an internal memory, returns a selected stored word on csr_rdata_o, and on an accepted r3type start captures rs1_i/rs2_i into internal state. It then updates internal xtea.done/opa/opb/sum/res state and drives result_o and valid_o according to funct3_i.

use-case flows.value: CSR write data stored into the selected key_mem entry
accepted r3type start that captures rs1_i and rs2_i and raises xtea.done(0)
xtea.sum and xtea.res updated from held operands, a selected key_mem word, and funct3_i
selected operation result and valid indication driven on result_o and valid_o
selected key_mem entry returned on csr_rdata_o
key_mem and xtea state fields cleared when rstn_i = '0'

conceptual assets.concept: The four CSR-stored 32-bit words used by the operation and readable through csr_rdata_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: The configure flow writes csr_wdata_i into key_mem when csr_we_i = '1' (lines 178-179). The read-out flow returns the selected stored word on csr_rdata_o (line 185). The operate flow also uses a selected key_mem word as tmp_z and then in tmp_r (lines 236-238), which feeds xtea.res and result_o (lines 222-224, 249). Integrity is established because wrong stored contents or wrong preservation would change both CSR readback and the reported operation result. Availability is also established because key_mem is edge-stored at line 179 and only cleared by reset at line 176. Confidentiality is not established because line 185 exposes the selected stored word directly.

conceptual assets.concept: The captured operand pair for an accepted operation step
conceptual assets.reasoning: On an accepted start, xtea.opa <= rs1_i and xtea.opb <= rs2_i (lines 204-206). Those held values are then consumed by the operation: xtea.sum can copy xtea.opa (line 214), tmp_a/tmp_b/tmp_x/tmp_y derive from xtea.opa and xtea.opb (lines 232-235), and xtea.res is updated from tmp_b and tmp_r (lines 221-224, 238). Integrity is established because later state and result computation depend on the exact captured operand values. Availability is also established because the operands are stored on the clock edge at lines 205-206 and held until used.

conceptual assets.concept: The operation sequencing state that marks an accepted request and then a valid result cycle
conceptual assets.reasoning: xtea.done(0) is cleared and xtea.done(1) takes the previous xtea.done(0) every clock (lines 200-201), and xtea.done(0) is asserted for an accepted start when start_i = '1' and rtype_i = r3type_c (lines 204-207). That state gates whether xtea.sum and xtea.res update (line 211), and valid_o reports xtea.done(1) for the operation funct3 values (lines 248-250). Integrity is established because this state decides when computation is performed and when the external result is marked valid. Availability is also established because an accepted start propagates through the stored xtea.done state to valid_o.

conceptual assets.concept: The running sum state used to select a stored word and contribute to the result computation
conceptual assets.reasoning: When xtea.done(0) = '1', xtea.sum is loaded from xtea.opa, incremented by xtea_delta_c, or decremented by xtea_delta_c depending on funct3_i (lines 213-218). Its bits then select which key_mem entry becomes tmp_z (lines 236-237), and xtea.sum also enters tmp_r directly (line 238). Integrity is established because both stored-word selection and result computation depend on the exact held sum state. Availability is also established because xtea.sum is an edge-stored state element that is preserved between updates and reset only at line 196.

conceptual assets.concept: The computed result word for the selected operation modes
conceptual assets.reasoning: When xtea.done(0) = '1', xtea.res is updated from tmp_b plus or minus tmp_r depending on funct3_i(1) (lines 221-224). result_select drives result_o <= xtea.res for the four operation funct3 values when rtype_i = r3type_c (lines 245, 247-250). Integrity is established because the external consumer must receive the exact computed word defined by those update rules. Availability is also established because the word is stored in xtea.res and exported on result_o whenever the selection conditions at lines 245 and 247-250 hold.
